title: Official Eurostat HICP deflator specification for EU energy-price comparisons
semesterAggregation: arithmetic mean of six monthly HICP index observations in each semester; explicitly disclose approximation vs weighted period consumption
requiredChecks: Same EU27_2020 geographic aggregate and HICP classification for all 12 months
Same HICP index reference base for all observations; never mix 2015=100 and 2025=100
Reject missing, suppressed or provisional observations until explicit handling documented
Do not substitute euro-area EA20 for EU27
Do not use HICP household inflation as an industrial-sector-specific deflator without labeling this proxy
Use matched nominal energy price units and same time period as deflator
reasonNotClosed: No verified official twelve-month EU27 HICP index vector in this artifact; cannot compute defensible real-price changes
